description.en: Locks the player out of talking to other NPCs (sets a global bit flag and shows the talk-lock icon), optionally restricting which specific NPC IDs remain talkable during the lock.
Optional variable list of NPC/character ID strings that should remain talkable while the lock is active.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Lock talking to other NPCs except a specific set of characters
StartTalkLock(TL_TYPE_B, 1, "evc0052", "evc0001", "evc0002", "evc0003", "evc0005", "evc0006");
